Throws away events that are waiting, so they are never delivered by [WaitEvent](WaitEvent). Without parameters everything goes. A kind removes only that one, a kind with the low byte zero such as $100 removes the whole group of keys, and a source removes only what came from there.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Flush", 20, 20, 240, 100, Desktop(), 3)
Delay 500
FlushEvents $100 ; drop the keys that were typed meanwhile
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
@param kind    Event kind or group to remove. Defaults to -1, which means all.
@param source  Only remove events from this object. Defaults to 0, which means any.
